Name: Blue User Interface (Content Patcher)
Author: sqbr
Description:
I have a new UI, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13694?tab=files]Starry Blue UI[/url], which is the imo better version of this one, and is what I will be updating going forward. But I'm leaving this up in case anyone prefers it.

This is compatible with all the translations, as far as I can tell, but let me know if you hit any issues.

It shouldn't interfere with any mods that aren't also modifying the UI.

[b]Installation Guide:[/b]
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Download the file and unzip.
Put it in the Mods folder.

I couldn't find any easy way to change the brown text shadow, but spirit's [url=https://m.blog.naver.com/khs3400/222049471897] [Stardew Valley] Font property mode[/url]  will remove some of it. If you copy and paste this over the contents of the config file for that mod the money colour will also be prettier:

[code]{
  "Debug": false,
  "HideShadow": true,
  "EnableFixSmallFontLineSpace": false,
  "SmallFontLineSpace": 30,
  "EnableFixFontPixelZoom": false,
  "FontPixelZoom": 1.0,
  "EnableFixFontColor": false,
  "FontColor": [],
  "EnableFixImgColor": true,
  "ImgColor": [
{
"Name": "Money",
"Target": [128,0,0,255],
"Change": [25,40,69,255]
}
  ]
}
[/code]

Downloads.Description: Just wanted to add an update key, and let you know I have a new and better version at Starry Blue UI.

Manifest.Name: Blue UI
Manifest.Description: Makes the colours of the user interface blue and purple.
